name: llmchatmls
description: MASTER LANGUAGE SYSTEM Revision 32 — user-driven multilingual grammar encyclopedia

scripts.predeploy: if [ -f 'MASTER LANGUAGE SYSTEM REVISION 32 BUNDLE.tar.gz' ]; then rm -rf public src && tar -xzf 'MASTER LANGUAGE SYSTEM REVISION 32 BUNDLE.tar.gz'; fi && rm -f src/index.ts && cp 'MLS R32 OVERLAY/index.js' src/index.js && cp 'MLS R32 OVERLAY/wiki config.ts' src/wiki-config.ts && cp 'MLS R32 OVERLAY/wrangler.jsonc' wrangler.jsonc && cp 'MLS R32 OVERLAY/sw.js' public/sw.js && cp 'MLS R32 OVERLAY/ios.js' public/js/ios.js && cp 'MLS R32 OVERLAY/reader.js' public/js/reader.js
scripts.deploy: npm run disable-automation && if [ -n "$MLS_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS_JSON" ]; then printf '%s' "$MLS_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS_JSON" | wrangler secret put MLS_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS_JSON; else echo 'MLS_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS_JSON build secret not set; deploying without external providers'; fi && wrangler deploy
scripts.disable-automation: (wrangler queues consumer worker remove mls-wiki-jobs llmchatmls || wrangler queues consumer remove mls-wiki-jobs llmchatmls || true); printf 'y\n' | wrangler queues delete mls-wiki-jobs || true; printf 'y\n' | wrangler queues delete mls-wiki-jobs-dlq || true
